items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: That's right, John Williams was in that Andy Kirk band, and Floyd Smith was on the guitar.

ctx.x: Yeah. Jim ... I know his name because he works for the subway now, if he hasn't passed away, because my wife was a friend of his wife's. And they also had a John Williams, MaryLou Williams' husband, who was a baritone sax player.
That's right, John Williams was in that Andy Kirk band, and Floyd Smith was on the guitar.
Oh, a great guitarist. Thigpen on drums, Ed Thigpen's father.
